headline: Tongi gas leak: Teenager dies after parents in fire
summary: A 16-year-old girl has died from severe burns, marking the third fatality in a gas leak fire that wiped out an entire family.
details: A 16-year-old girl named Tanisha died this morning at the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery in Dhaka after suffering severe burns in a gas leak fire.
Tanisha had 86 percent burns on her body and had been undergoing treatment in the intensive care unit (ICU) since Wednesday.
Her parents, 60-year-old Lal Chan and 50-year-old Nasima, had already passed away at the same hospital on Wednesday evening.
Lal Chan suffered 95 percent burns, while Nasima had 85 percent burns on their bodies.
The incident occurred on October 21 around 7:00 am at their rented house in the Mudafa area of Tongi, Gazipur.
Neighbors rescued the family members and rushed them to the burn institute in critical condition.
caption:
A gas leak fire in Tongi has claimed the lives of an entire family, including a 16-year-old girl who died two days after her parents.

A 16-year-old girl named Tanisha died this morning at the National Institute of Burn and Plastic Surgery in Dhaka after suffering severe burns in a gas leak fire.

Tanisha had 86 percent burns on her body and had been undergoing treatment in the intensive care unit (ICU) since Wednesday.

Her parents, 60-year-old Lal Chan and 50-year-old Nasima, had already passed away at the same hospital on Wednesday evening.

Lal Chan suffered 95 percent burns, while Nasima had 85 percent burns on their bodies.

The incident occurred on October 21 around 7:00 am at their rented house in the Mudafa area of Tongi, Gazipur.

Neighbors rescued the family members and rushed them to the burn institute in critical condition.

headline: 3 killed in ambulance-bus collision in Faridpur
summary: A head-on crash between a Kingfisher Paribahan bus and an ambulance on the Dhaka-Khulna highway left three dead and four injured.
details: Three people, including two men and a woman, were killed and four others injured in a head-on collision between an ambulance and a bus in the Arkandi area of Madhukhali upazila, Faridpur.
The accident occurred around 2:00 PM on the Dhaka-Khulna highway when a Magura-bound ambulance from Faridpur collided with a Dhaka-bound Kingfisher Paribahan bus.
Three passengers of the ambulance died on the spot, while four others sustained injuries.
Police and fire service personnel responded to the scene to recover the bodies and rescue the injured passengers.
Abdus Salam, officer-in-charge of Karimpur Highway Police Station, confirmed that the bus has been seized by the police as legal procedures are underway.
caption:
3 dead and 4 injured after an ambulance and a bus collide head-on in Faridpur.

Three people, including two men and a woman, were killed and four others injured in a head-on collision between an ambulance and a bus in the Arkandi area of Madhukhali upazila, Faridpur.

The accident occurred around 2:00 PM on the Dhaka-Khulna highway when a Magura-bound ambulance from Faridpur collided with a Dhaka-bound Kingfisher Paribahan bus.

Three passengers of the ambulance died on the spot, while four others sustained injuries.

Police and fire service personnel responded to the scene to recover the bodies and rescue the injured passengers.

Abdus Salam, officer-in-charge of Karimpur Highway Police Station, confirmed that the bus has been seized by the police as legal procedures are underway.
